title: Cyberpunk Apartment

candidates.title: Cloud banks travelling between the towers
candidates.action: Move coherent cloud shapes across several skyline depths, with clear gaps and near towers staying sharp.
candidates.method: Source-texture transport and separately renewed gap mist; preserve both source taps and destination silhouettes. V3 has translating density patterns, not a complete source-cloud transport pass.
candidates.acceptance: A recognizable cloud edge moves at full-scene720p without dragging a tower or producing a flat fog stripe.
candidates.asset_requirement: Existing clean plate; new source masks must be traced at native size.

candidates.title: Convincing irregular road traffic
candidates.action: Clear vehicle bodies and distinct head/tail lights follow the existing near and elevated roads, with pairs, gaps and safe headways.
candidates.method: Replace normalized10s whole-route travel with source-space speed and explicit event births/occlusion. Perspective-scaled silhouettes, premultiplied edges, contact/reflection response. Preserve the removed hovering-car repairs.
candidates.acceptance: Traffic reads as vehicles on asphalt at normal size; no overtaking collisions, curb-following errors, floating lights or repeating short tile.
candidates.asset_requirement: Existing clean plate; new source masks must be traced at native size.

candidates.title: A rare commuter shuttle on the elevated road
candidates.action: One longer illuminated bus crosses the existing elevated roadway, briefly disappearing behind towers.
candidates.method: Road vehicle, not a new railway or aircraft. Low-contrast body with a few attached windows and wet-road response; one passage in a proposed3-5min interval.
candidates.acceptance: The body remains aligned with the road and correctly occluded, and the larger transit moment feels occasional.
candidates.asset_requirement: New small vehicle asset or a carefully projected procedural body; inspect its geometry before a full pass.

candidates.title: Independent sign programmes with local light spill
candidates.action: A few existing large signs have readable travelling heads, dimmer holds and different rhythms.
candidates.method: Map complete existing emitters including white cores; preserve glyphs. Give each sign its own schedule and drive nearby haze and surfaces from that same signal.
candidates.acceptance: At least two signs visibly change in the full scene; city exposure and building edges remain fixed.
candidates.asset_requirement: Existing clean plate; new source masks must be traced at native size.

candidates.title: Reflections that belong to each light source
candidates.action: Selected sign and traffic changes echo in the river, wet roads and the cool floor strip.
candidates.method: One emission signal per source with separate perspective-mapped receiver masks; calm source-detail-preserving water motion. Retain warm furniture reflections.
candidates.acceptance: Colour, timing and apparent source position agree; river motion has no shoreline tearing or broad floor wobble.
candidates.asset_requirement: Existing clean plate; new source masks must be traced at native size.

candidates.title: Refractive droplets with trails and occasional merging
candidates.action: Several readable close glass drops bead, stick and slide while finer rain stays outside.
candidates.method: Replace a few flat bead marks with local source-valid refraction, a narrow highlight and a fading wet trail; selected merge events need continuous volume/paths.
candidates.acceptance: Drops survive normal-size viewing; refraction never samples a frame or interior object and trails do not cover the view.
candidates.asset_requirement: Existing clean plate; new source masks must be traced at native size.

candidates.title: Ventilation vapour in the lower city
candidates.action: Two anchored exhaust plumes rise from verified rooftop outlets, then drift into the existing street mist.
candidates.method: Choose actual flues in the source before drawing anchors; broad overlapping wisps, wind-linked drift and building occlusion.
candidates.acceptance: Plumes clearly leave their outlets and stay behind intervening masonry; no emission from an invented antenna.
candidates.asset_requirement: Trace actual visible outlets first; if no convincing outlet is present, retain this as gap mist instead.

candidates.title: Better cup steam against the dark sofa
candidates.action: Soft uneven wisps leave the existing cup, separate and disperse rather than drawing a repeating corkscrew.
candidates.method: Keep the cup and table fixed; broaden the useful vapour footprint and vary density independently of the neon programmes.
candidates.acceptance: Visible but quiet at720p, attached to the liquid surface, with no repeated spiral or smoke-like plume.
candidates.asset_requirement: Existing clean plate; new source masks must be traced at native size.

candidates.title: Occupied windows and existing mast lights
candidates.action: A few complete apartment windows hold different occupied states; selected existing mast lights have readable small bright centres.
candidates.method: Trace larger real panes and hardware instead of scattering random dots. Most windows stay steady; source-mounted beacon halos remain bounded.
candidates.acceptance: Window states are local and independently held; no whole-district breathing or lights placed in haze.
candidates.asset_requirement: Existing clean plate; new source masks must be traced at native size.

candidates.title: One warm practical with coupled reflections
candidates.action: The table lamp has an occasional gentle hesitation, shared by its nearby pool and marble reflection.
candidates.method: Reuse the Crater lamp core/spill method with new source geometry. Include the white bulb; keep most room lighting steady and use a long attention clock.
candidates.acceptance: Core, nearby table and warm reflected contribution dip together; no room-wide exposure change or constant flicker.
candidates.asset_requirement: Existing clean plate; new source masks must be traced at native size.

candidates.title: A few leaves moving in indoor ventilation
candidates.action: Only selected leaf tips bend gently from their attachments while stems, pot and sofa remain anchored.
candidates.method: Use isolated leaf elements over a clean background; do not warp the whole plant or smear the scene behind it. A constrained test earns inclusion.
candidates.acceptance: No doubled original leaf, rubbery edge or displaced pot; the movement is subtle and credible at source scale.
candidates.asset_requirement: Requires leaf separation and a clean revealed background patch; existing V3 deliberately keeps the plant static.

candidates.title: An occasional river service ferry
candidates.action: A small utility boat crosses a verified open-water route with a narrow wake and a soft reflected light.
candidates.method: Map a true water corridor, bridge/building occlusion and perspective before making an asset. Keep the passage sparse over several minutes.
candidates.acceptance: A solid hull sits on water with a restrained wake; no crossing dry terraces, emerging through a bridge or bright floating dot.
candidates.asset_requirement: New vessel asset plus independently reviewed water/occlusion masks; optional after the main city pass is accepted.

knowledge_reuse.use: Normal-size readability, bright bounded emitter cores/longer holds, source-linked spill, true road placement and premultiplied tiny-asset edges.
knowledge_reuse.limit: Positive V5 feedback; no transferable numeric gains or automatic approval for a new source.

knowledge_reuse.use: Separate absolute attention clock from a shorter environmental phase; keep event clocks continuous across chunks.
knowledge_reuse.limit: The600s schedule is a proposal, not implemented long-animation evidence.

knowledge_reuse.use: Source and destination occlusion, source-tap checks, full structure context and matching light core/spill.
knowledge_reuse.limit: New scene geometry needs new masks; scene approval does not transfer.

knowledge_reuse.use: Different depth speeds and one cue envelope shared by visible weather and sound.
knowledge_reuse.limit: Borrow the method, not sandstorm density, strike count or source-specific levels.

knowledge_reuse.use: Inward glass masks, surface-preserving motion and restrained mapped display activity.
knowledge_reuse.limit: Source-specific techniques; Shoreless rejected the large waveform, and isolated numeric checks are not playback approval.

gates: Audit the exact original art and current encoded baseline; freeze hashes before any source repair.
Trace both sampled-source support and output protection, plus solid foreground occluders. Planning pins are not effect masks.
Eight-to-twelve-second isolated tests at full composition and actual frame rate, followed by one combined visible core pass.
Inspect unamplified720p at1x plus native crops; then an A/B with matching viewpoint and disclosed timing changes.
No camera drift, whole-scene dissolve, geometry wobble, synchronized skyline/room exposure or unmotivated repeated dramatic events.
Build a genuine60s environmental cycle and a separate600s attention clock; validate states/velocity/occlusion at joins and across chunks.
Decode every frame and timestamp, compare native-to-encoded controls and regional seam steps, and keep user playback acceptance separate.
Render accepted native-frame effects directly to4K with explicitBT709/TV handling and disclosed source upscaling; current intro once at assembly.
